subject: ela
intro: Pick the clear, on-topic, task-appropriate writing.

items.prompt:
For a PERSUASIVE essay about uniforms, which sentence fits?
A) I believe uniforms make mornings easier.
B) Once upon a time a wizard appeared.
C) I like pizza.
items.answer: A) I believe uniforms make mornings easier.

steps: An opinion fits a persuasive essay. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) I believe uniforms make mornings easier.

items.prompt:
In a paragraph about the solar system, which is OFF topic?
A) Mars is the fourth planet.
B) Saturn has rings.
C) I like pizza.

steps: Not about the solar system. Key is C.

items.prompt:
A NARRATIVE prompt should be answered with a:
A) story
B) grocery list
C) math problem

steps: Match the task. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Writing should fit its task, purpose, and:
A) audience
B) page color
C) font size only

steps: Consider the readers. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Which sentence would NOT fit a how-to about a science experiment?
A) First, gather your materials.
B) Next, record your observations.
C) My cousin loves soccer.

To keep a paragraph clear, it should focus on:
A) one main idea
B) many unrelated ideas
C) no idea

You must write a report on climate. The BEST structure is:
A) an introduction to the topic, a body of organized facts, and a conclusion
B) random sentences about climate and your pets
C) one sentence only
items.answer: A) an introduction to the topic, a body of organized facts, and a conclusion

steps: Organized, on topic. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) an introduction to the topic, a body of organized facts, and a conclusion

items.prompt:
Which paragraph is the most COHERENT?
A) I have a bike. The sun is far. Math is fun.
B) Our team practiced hard. We learned to pass well. In our last game, that teamwork helped us win.
C) Bike sun math win.
items.answer: B) Our team practiced hard. We learned to pass well. In our last game, that teamwork helped us win.

steps: Connected, on-topic sentences. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) Our team practiced hard. We learned to pass well. In our last game, that teamwork helped us win.
